Found and NOT fixed (pre-existing basis choice in PR #360, out of scope for an attestation-only commit): the two consumers judge staleness against different instants on the same run -- evaluateConditions uses wall-clock `opts.now ?? Date.now()` while renewalSignals uses `new Date(referenceDate())` = UTC midnight of REPORT_DATE ?? today. Demonstrated with a record stamped 2026-08-17T20:00Z on run date 2026-09-22: renewalSignals grades it fresh (at-risk) all day, evaluateConditions grades it fresh at 00:00Z and stale at 21:00Z. Live divergence is bounded to one calendar day at the 35-day edge; under a REPORT_DATE pin it can be arbitrary. evaluateConditions' own header says only the workbook-stale check uses wall-clock now, so the consistent fix is to judge AR staleness as of `asOf` in conditions.ts (one line, plus the pinned 'oldest import 50 days ago' text in collections-stale-ar.test.ts becomes 49) -- recommended as a follow-up.
